decisions.reason: A startup accelerator program lies far from the firm's machinery and recycling engineering knowledge, so the firm can hardly interpret or learn from its results, and its resources are better used in the core recycling business.

The bio-based bitumen binder needs materials-chemistry knowledge beyond the firm's machinery base, but it is presented as a flagship and draws on its in-house R&D on converting waste into feedstocks, so it is likely kept for now.

The infectious waste decontamination plant extends the firm's WASTX treatment technology, is backed by a partnership with ERMAFA and its own R&D, and is a flagship, so the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve it.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant sits squarely within the firm's modular recycling machinery expertise, which makes it easy to evaluate and refine.
